ex.en: The building code sets safety standards for every dwelling.
ex.zh: 建築法規為每一種住宅訂定安全標準。

ex.en: The survey counted each occupied dwelling in the district.
ex.zh: 這項調查統計了該區每一戶有人居住的住所。

dwelling.en: a house or other place where people live

ex.en: In the story, a dwarf lives deep inside a mountain.
ex.zh: 故事裡有個矮人住在山的深處。

ex.en: The dwarf in the fairy tale was good at making tools.
ex.zh: 童話裡的矮人很會做工具。

ex.en: The book describes a dwarf who guards a golden treasure.
ex.zh: 這本書描寫了一位守護金色寶藏的矮人。

ex.en: The tall tower dwarfs every other building in the city.
ex.zh: 這座高塔讓城裡所有其他建築都相形見絀。

ex.en: Her success dwarfed all of our earlier results.
ex.zh: 她的成功讓我們先前所有的成績都顯得微不足道。

ex.en: Rabbits dwell in holes under the hill.
ex.zh: 兔子住在山丘下的洞裡。

ex.en: Few people dwell in this remote valley.
ex.zh: 很少有人住在這個偏遠的山谷。

ex.en: Try not to dwell on your mistakes.
She dwelled on the argument for days.
ex.zh: 她為那場爭吵耿耿於懷了好幾天。
